name: superseded-by-new-tab
description: Director closes this tab's socket with 4000 "New connection opened" (the session was opened in another tab). With NEXT_PUBLIC_STUDIO_ONE_LIVE_TAB the hook goes to `superseded` and schedules no reconnect: no new socket for minutes, none after an offline/online pair, a send shows the notice and goes nowhere. Flag off, the same close starts today's backoff.
